content.title: Garden Supplies List
content.body:
This note details the task of compiling a list of necessary supplies for the vegetable garden.

## Task Details
- **Content**: Compile a list of necessary supplies including soil, containers or raised bed materials, seeds, basic gardening tools, and a watering system (consider drip irrigation).
- **Goal**: Gather all necessary materials for starting the garden.
- **Deadline**: 2023-04-15
- **Notes**: Ensure all items are suitable for a small-scale beginner garden. Research cost-effective options for drip irrigation.
